meta.prompt: Show the plan for migrating my blog as steps: six steps with a short description each. A start button runs them one after another (a second or two each) with a spinner on the running step, ticks on the finished ones, a progress bar and the time elapsed, a pause button, and a summary when all are done.
meta.text:
I'm sorry, but I can't write this one in the notation. The validator errors describe a different format (JSON nodes with "slots" and "bind" props), not the line notation I've been asked to use, so I can't map them onto this format.

The fixes that apply to the notation are these, and I've made them below. ListTile takes no children, so each step's icon, title and description now sit inside a Row/Column instead. Every variable used in a string or binding is declared with `state` first, including `elapsed`, `progress`, `status`, the done flags and `allDone`.

state status="idle"
state elapsed=0
state progress=0
state done1=false
state done2=false
state done3=false
state done4=false
state done5=false
state done6=false
state allDone=false
Card gap:12 pad:16 w:390
  Text.title "Blog migration"
  Row between
    Text.muted "Elapsed: {elapsed}s"
    Badge.info "{status}"
  Progress =progress
  Row gap:8
    Button.primary "Start" -> status="running"; emit start
    Button.secondary "Pause" -> status="paused"; emit pause
  Column gap:8
    Row gap:8
      if done1
        Icon "check"
      if !done1
        CircularProgressIndicator
      Column gap:2
        Text.strong "1. Back up the current blog"
        Text.muted "Export all posts, pages and media to a safe archive."
    Row gap:8
      if done2
        Icon "check"
      if !done2
        CircularProgressIndicator
      Column gap:2
        Text.strong "2. Export content"
        Text.muted "Convert posts and comments into a portable format."
    Row gap:8
      if done3
        Icon "check"
      if !done3
        CircularProgressIndicator
      Column gap:2
        Text.strong "3. Set up the new host"
        Text.muted "Provision hosting, domain and the blog software."
    Row gap:8
      if done4
        Icon "check"
      if !done4
        CircularProgressIndicator
      Column gap:2
        Text.strong "4. Import content"
        Text.muted "Load posts, pages, media and comments into the new site."
    Row gap:8
      if done5
        Icon "check"
      if !done5
        CircularProgressIndicator
      Column gap:2
        Text.strong "5. Redirects and SEO"
        Text.muted "Map old URLs to new ones so search rankings are kept."
    Row gap:8
      if done6
        Icon "check"
      if !done6
        CircularProgressIndicator
      Column gap:2
        Text.strong "6. Switch DNS and verify"
        Text.muted "Point the domain at the new site and check every page."
  if allDone
    Card gap:4
      Text.success "Migration complete"
      Text.body "All 6 steps finished in {elapsed}s."
